matrices.title: hand
matrices.scope: Complete NGDA singular/plural morphology; plural reference cells do not assign an unneeded mass/abstract number sense. Selected hand/hande/hande/hand; handa in obliques remains an accepted variant. The glossary p297 explicitly labels hand (51.1.3), extending the endingless accusative rule51.1 to this headword even though its short exemplar list does not name hand. Bare hand in on his swīðran hand is accusative in a bounded side-expression. The following unassigned source line8 repeats it with static standað, so its case must not be explained by movement alone.
